headline: Pays a Franklin Elementary support specialist up to $57,500 for "at promise" students
summary: The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a contract with an individual contractor at Franklin Elementary School for the 2020-21 school year. The contractor will run daily support groups, give one-on-one help to "at promise" students, contact their parents, train Franklin staff, and lead parent workshops in families' primary languages. Pay is capped at $57,500.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Elizabeth Gomez - Rudsdale Newcomer High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 between the District and  Elizabeth Gomez, San Leandro, CA, for the latter to provide advocacy for students as they deal with the health care system as well as create a training for students to become Health Advocates themselves; teach a Health Advocacy elective course on Wednesdays; participate in COST team focused on supporting students dealing with MediCal and appointments, at Rudsdale Newcomer High School, for the period of August 3, 2020 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $35,000.00.
funding_source: Measure N
headline: Pays a health advocate up to $35,000 to support students at Rudsdale Newcomer High
summary: The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a 2020-21 contract with an individual contractor at Rudsdale Newcomer High School, paid with Measure N funds. The contractor will help students navigate the health care system, train students to become health advocates, teach a Health Advocacy elective on Wednesdays, and join the school team supporting students with MediCal and appointments. Pay is capped at $35,000.
source_issue: The action text gives the agreement period as August 3, 2020 through June 30, 2020, an end date that falls before the start date, so the actual term is unclear.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding - Girls Inc. of Alameda County - After School Program - West Oakland Middle School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding between the District and Girls Inc. of Alameda County, Oakland, CA, for the latter to serve as lead agency for program coordination, math intervention, homework support, student supervision and a variety of enrichment services, as described in the MOU, for West Oakland Middle School’s comprehensive After School Program, for the period of August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021, in an amount not to exceed $88,558.00.
funding_source: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant
headline: Pays Girls Inc. of Alameda County up to $88,558 to run West Oakland Middle's after-school program
summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Girls Inc. of Alameda County to lead West Oakland Middle School's after-school program, including program coordination, math help, homework support, student supervision and enrichment activities. The agreement is for up to $88,558 and runs from August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021. It is funded by the After School Education and Safety (ASES) grant.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
